frozen_run_design.source: spec/nuisance_spec.json; the command line cannot override any of it

log_d_epidermis.rule: source_verified and conversion_verified must both be true, and an inexact conversion must carry conversion_approximation_declared
log_d_epidermis.basis: source and conversion verified, and an inexact conversion declares itself

log_d_papillary.rule: anchor_source_verified must be true and population_prior_phrasing_forbidden must be true
log_d_papillary.basis: anchor verified and population-prior phrasing forbidden

log_d_reticular.rule: anchor_source_verified must be true and population_prior_phrasing_forbidden must be true
log_d_reticular.basis: anchor verified and population-prior phrasing forbidden

log_mus_scale.rule: source_verified and conversion_verified must both be true, and an inexact conversion must carry conversion_approximation_declared
log_mus_scale.basis: source and conversion verified, and an inexact conversion declares itself

mus_slope.rule: anchor_source_verified must be true and population_prior_phrasing_forbidden must be true
mus_slope.basis: anchor verified and population-prior phrasing forbidden; its stress variant is pre-registered with phrasing forbidden

citation_gate.rule: No transport may be submitted while this gate is closed. The release above covers the feasibility gate only, within release_scope.

preflight.verdict: the real executor reproduces the production forward solver at eta = 0, the AD path is live on every column, and repeated calls with the same keys are bitwise identical

deterministic_flag.why_checked_here: a preflight record describes the process that ran the preflight, not this one

plan.units: dimensionless, log of a thickness scale
plan.estimator_plan: AD against the ensemble central difference; pMC cannot differentiate this column

convergence.denominator: the paired standard error of e3 - e2, not SE(e2)
convergence.why: the two fits share the same difference quotients, so their difference is far less noisy than either one and SE(e2) understates the truncation

equivalence_test.design: pre-registered equivalence, not failure to reject
equivalence_test.equivalence_margin_basis: a relative discrepancy of five percent in a nuisance Jacobian column. This is a NECESSARY column-level agreement criterion and nothing more: it carries no claim about any downstream classification. The earlier justification from the headroom of the final thresholds is WITHDRAWN, having been measured to be false, and is not restated here so that a search for it finds nothing. See results/margin_safety_analysis.json and, in the spec, column_margin_alone_does_not_certify_a_classification.
equivalence_test.why_not_failure_to_reject: a max-T test that does not reject shows absence of evidence. At six replicates that is mostly a statement about power, so it cannot certify agreement.
equivalence_test.support_rule: a component is excluded only when BOTH the reference and the quantity being checked are at or below 1e-12 of the largest magnitude across components. Masking on the reference alone would hide a component where the reference vanishes and the alternative does not, which is a disagreement, not an absence of signal.
equivalence_test.downstream_contract: any Fisher matrix built from this column must use the same support mask; excluded components carry no comparison and must not silently contribute information
equivalence_test.degenerate_spread_rule: a supported component whose replicate standard deviation is below 0.05 of the column median blocks the comparison: six replicates cannot distinguish a genuinely tiny spread from a collapsed sample, and the interval would be absurdly narrow either way
equivalence_test.reason: 26 supported component(s) have a collapsed replicate spread, so no trustworthy interval can be formed for them

convergence.rule: converged when the simultaneous upper confidence bound on the relative truncation, |e3 - e2| over the reference magnitude, falls inside the pre-registered equivalence margin. Failure to reject a zero-difference null is NOT convergence: at six replicates that would mostly report low power. A column that is blocked, inequivalent or unresolved is not converged and the gate refuses to proceed for it.

log_d_epidermis.reason: the h^2 extrapolation is not established for this column, so there is no trustworthy reference to compare AD against and no estimator route is assigned
log_d_epidermis.what_to_change: the moderate-h window, not the result: a column that fails here needs a different step grid or more replicates
